roles.usage_summary: Scaled expression within PsychAD subcohorts, estimated PEER factors, residualized expression and quantile normalized it. Used FastQTL discoveries to choose a factor count closest to 95% of the maximum, then repeated the procedure after combining subcohorts. External ROSMAP/FACS-MG validation used PEER-residualized expression.
roles.required_caution: Factor-count search, scaling, quantile normalization, subcohort combination and prediction validation are separate pipeline steps. The factor-grid increment, ties, author seed and PEER edition are not recovered.
reported_factor_counts: 5 to 50; closest to 95% of the maximum eQTL count

roles.required_caution: Keep expression, splicing and protein matrices/counts distinct. STAR/RSEM/LeafCutter processing, FastQTL/tensorQTL models and interaction testing are separate. The PEER edition and complete author settings remain unknown.

roles.required_caution: Keep perturbation/averaging definitions and the reported Q-value thresholds distinct. Inverse-normal transformation, donor random effects and FastQTL/LME fits are not performed by the PEER core. Author edition and full settings remain unreported.

roles.usage_summary: Calculated PEER v1.3 factors from inverse-normal-transformed gene-expression residuals. Compared APEX eGene discovery for 0-100 factors by ten and chose the count after which eGene gains were below 1%: 40 for GTEx and 20 for FUSION.
roles.required_caution: Zero factors is a no-PEER QTL baseline, not an implicit zero-factor call to the dense core. The gain denominator, tie/boundary handling, author seed and executed commit are unstated; version-label agreement does not prove the paper used this source commit.
